chapters.title: Pearl Harbor to jump wings
chapters.note: Danny I enlists, runs Currahee with Easy Company and earns his wings at Benning before shipping to England.

chapters.title: Normandy to the Eagle's Nest
chapters.note: D-Day, losing Bill at Carentan, Holland, Bastogne and Foy, and the end of the war in Europe.

chapters.title: Home, and a son
chapters.note: Danny I comes home without Bill. Danny II is born into a house built around not talking.

chapters.title: Into the water
chapters.note: Danny II joins the Navy, gets through UDT training and checks aboard SEAL Team TWO at Little Creek.

chapters.title: Vietnam
chapters.note: A tour with 8th Platoon: Tet at Chau Doc, the Rung Sat, home again. Then a son, and a second tour.

chapters.title: Loaned wings
chapters.note: Danny III grows up: Grandpa's wings, Dad building a new team, the divorce, and graduation.

chapters.title: Third generation
chapters.note: Danny III enlists, gets through Hell Week and checks aboard his father's old team.

chapters.title: Chief
chapters.note: Moving out, making Chief with Dad watching, the wedding, and the last years before the towers.

chapters.title: After the towers
chapters.note: September 11th, Grandpa's last week and burial with his wings, a first house, then Afghanistan.

chapters.title: Ajax
chapters.note: Green Team at thirty-five, and the dog who went through every door first.

chapters.title: Abbottabad
chapters.note: The mock-up, the raid, Dad's last week, and retiring after twenty-two years.

chapters.title: Starting over
chapters.note: Ajax comes home and goes, a degree, a first app, a first hire, and a garden that finally bloomed.
